rationale: Eye-level from the bed-wall side (eye z=1.62, 33 cm off the bed wall) facing the door wall straight on: the room-centered troffer (z -0.6..0.0) sits ~2 m ahead so it renders upper-middle-right with ceiling margin above, matching ref 01; doorway right of center per the 0.25 m door pin; floor foreground below like the v2 reference. The original eye (z=0.4) stood nearly under the lens, which put it steeply overhead and out of frame at any level/down tilt -- the eye pull-back (not a troffer geometry change) is the fix.

Raised-eye (1.85 m, tall observer) facing the bed wall (+z) from just off the door wall, gaze slightly right and up: the room-centered troffer renders upper-middle-right clear of the top edge with ceiling margin above, echoing ref 02's right-side lens placement; baseboard and floor strip stay visible so the back-wall ratio stays measurable (1.86 vs ref 2.09, within 15%). From a 1.6 m eye the lens top edge and the wall base span more than the 48-degree vertical budget from the door wall (measured over 19 iterated captures), so no 1.6 m tilt fits both; raising the eye (not touching troffer geometry) is the fix. fov 48 unchanged, far wall fills the frame.

Low camera looking steeply up at the door-wall ceiling corner: ceiling dominates, door wall and leaf drop into the lower-right frame. Look height 2.3 stays below the 2.4 m ceiling. Rescaled x/depth from the old placement.

In the doorway plane on the door axis (x=0.25 pin) at eye level, angled toward the far corner: doorway viewpoint with the room opening beyond (casing-edge framing not achieved, see doc). Rescaled x/depth from the old placement.

Mid-room below-ceiling camera tilted steeply up toward the door-wall ceiling junction: ceiling fills the frame, door head at the bottom edge. Look height 2.3 stays below the 2.4 m ceiling. Rescaled x/depth from the old placement.

Low closeup square on a plain stretch of the bed wall away from corners and the leaf: floor fills the foreground flat to the frame edge, straight cove base at the junction, wall above, like the v2 reference. Rescaled x/depth from the old placement.
